thread:
mira: rolled out microstream + early-exit pruning to canary (20% traffic). quick post with numbers.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started 1976543209 by mira — 20% route -> microstream-early-exit:v1
alex_k: nice. any baseline % numbers? p50/p95/p99 and cost impact?
mira: short summary from the canary window (30m):
- p50 latency: -18%
- p95 latency: -12%
- p99 latency: -22%
- token compute cost per request: -12%
- end-to-end GPU utilization: +8% (more steady packing)
- observed improvement strongest on short-to-mid seqs (<=512)

bryan: are these system-wide or just for the canary model shards? link to dashboards? :eyes:
mira: canary model shards only atm. dashboards: https://internal.redwood/dashboard/runtime/canary/microstream-eex (perm required)
sam: did we run the eval suite for quality/regression? early-exit makes me nervous about truncated outputs.
mira: yes — ran prompt-regression-suite v3.2 across our standard evals; f1/rouge/semantic-sim metrics within noise (±0.5%). added guard: early-exit only triggers when next-token confidence delta < 0.002 for >=3 consecutive steps.
lia: config flag name so infra knows how to toggle? also add to rollout playbook.
mira: flag: "serve.enable_microstream_early_exit". canary config in repo: infra/rollouts/microstream_eex/canary.yaml
alex_k: any incidents during canary? memory/gpu OOMs?
opsbot: ALERT at 1976543240: transient kernel memory spike on shard gpu-12 (increase +14%). auto-throttle applied.
mira: saw that — throttled canary from 20% -> 10% for 6min, adjusted kernel batch-window param (microstream.batch_max_tokens -> 2048 -> 1536) and resumed to 30% after verifying stability.
bryan: great that we could bump to 30%. what's the rollout plan next? slow bump or full flip?
mira: plan: 30% -> 60% after 2h stable metrics, run full-regression nightly, ramp to 100% after 24h with ops sign-off. I'll open the rollout PR now with the checklist.
mira: PR: https://git.redwood/inference/rollouts/pull/487 — includes perf graphs, experiment configs, rollback steps.
sam: ping me if you want a hand running adversarial prompts overnight.
lia: adding playbook note: if p99 increases by >10% on any region, rollback to previous kernel param and open incident.
alex_k: can you paste the curl command to query the canary perf summary? saves me a click.
mira: sure:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RBW_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.internal.redwood/infra/canary_metrics?exp=microstream_eex&window=30m" | jq '.summary'
```
bryan: thumbs up. please add the perf dive to the weekly eng-runtime sync slides.
mira: done — put slides in drive: https://drive.redwood/eng-runtime/weekly/2026-03-23
opsbot: NOTE: auto-monitoring rule created: runtime.microstream_eex.p99 > baseline*1.1 triggers paging to oncall
mira: thanks team. tagging @oncall for visibility. will post a follow-up if anything regresses or when we hit 100%. :rocket:
